summary: gitpebble: a crafted repository URL runs commands during clone (CVSS 8.8)
details: gitpebble 3.0.0 to 3.1.9 passes part of a repository URL to a shell when it clones. Anything that clones a URL it does not control with gitpebble can be made to run commands. Fixed in gitpebble 3.2.0.

database_specific.note: Invented for the triage-evals test cases. Not a real advisory: it describes no real vulnerability.
